frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster sprite for a Korean dark medieval fantasy game UI, matching the existing warm saturated gold metal and deep crimson heraldry with bold near-black illustrated outlines. Generate ONE complete square gold rectangular border ONLY on a genuinely transparent canvas, at 1024x1024. This is a Unity 9-sliced frame, not a finished popup. The border bounding rectangle runs from about x64 y64 to x960 y960; all four sides are perfectly straight and axis-aligned. Compact symmetric angular bevel corner fittings stay entirely within each 180x180 corner region. Thick black outline, warm gold bevel with pale gold highlights, darker bronze shading. Top and bottom central edges are continuous SIMPLE straight gold rails, side middle edges also SIMPLE rails: no large midpoint emblems, no repeating pattern, no wavy line, no horns, no flags, no diamonds halfway along an edge, no round corners. Border visually about 24 pixels thick; corners modest not oversized. Entire rectangular interior transparent, entire exterior transparent, no background color, no glow or shadow outside the outline. No words, no icons, no panels, no labels, no guide lines or nine-slice marks. Straight edge center bands must stretch cleanly to a short wide reward panel or tall synergy tooltip. Crisp clean hand-painted 2D game illustration, front view with zero perspective.
ornament: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster sprite for the SAME Korean dark medieval fantasy UI: warm saturated gold beveled metal, deep crimson and near-black ink outlines. Generate ONE small symmetrical heraldic crest on genuinely transparent canvas, 1024x512 landscape. A golden angular horned demon helmet sits in the center, two SHORT downward crimson pennants flank it, with small angular gold caps and no other imagery. Gold helmet and horns occupy most of center width, short pennants to either side, readable as a compact 2D ornament when displayed 104 pixels wide and 52 pixels tall. All decoration fits within centered x180..844 y50..460, isolated with substantial transparent margins. It will sit separately above a popup border, NOT attached to any frame. No long horizontal rails, no rectangle, no background, no text, no skull realism, no glow, no lighting on the transparent canvas, no additional elements. Crisp front-facing hand-painted medieval 2D game illustration with bold black contour, polished pale-gold highlights and bronze shading, saturated burgundy fabric. The current game's motifs are a stylized gold horned helmet and crimson banners; match that aesthetic.
